title: Accharā
text: Accharāgaṇasaṅghuṭṭhaṃ || pisācagaṇasevitaṃ || vanan-tam mohanaṃ nāma || kathaṃ yātrā bhavissatīti || || Ujuko nāma so maggo || abhayā nāma sā disā || ratho akujano nāma || dhammacakkehi saṃyuto || || Hirī tassa apālambo || saty-assa parivāraṇam || dhammāhaṃ sārathiṃ brūmi || sammādiṭṭhipure javaṃ || || Yassa etādisaṃ yānaṃ || itthiyā purisassa vā || sa ve etena yānena || nibbānass-eva santike ti || ||
